blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Intent-based networking (IBN) promises QoS provisioning in which the network derives the configuration from operator-stated goals. Its first step, translating a natural-language intent into enforceable service-level objectives (SLOs) grounded in a live snapshot of the network state, increasingly relies on large language models (LLMs). These large models add cost and energy to the management loop and typically require multi-GPU, cloud-hosted infrastructure. Can lightweight open LLMs take over this step dependably? We answer this question with a five-dimensional evaluation of ten LLMs with <10B parameters from five families, under four prompting setups, on 716 placement intents. We evaluate translation performance, intent validation, hallucination, energy impact, and robustness to diverse phrasing. The best configurations translate intents with a strict F1 of 0.943 and reject up to 191 of 195 invalid intents. With few-shot reasoning, the strongest models hallucinate unsupported QoS requirements in only about one response in a hundred, whereas the zero-shot setup struggles. A translated intent costs 0.044-0.148 Wh of GPU energy without reasoning, and added energy cost for reasoning pays off for the weaker models. Furthermore, we show that realistic rephrasing lowers the rejection of invalid intents in 15 of 16 configurations for the best-performing models, leaving robust intent validation as a key open challenge for reliable IBN. Our code and data are available: https://github.com/ggck43/intent2slo.
blocks.zh: 基于意向的网络(IBN)承诺提供QoS,网络从操作员陈述的目标中获取配置. 其第一步,将自然语言意图转化为可执行的服务级目标(SLOs),以网络状态的现场快照为基础,越来越依赖于大型语言模型(LLMs). 这些大型模型为管理循环增加了成本和能量,通常需要多GPU,云宿基础设施. 轻量级开放LLMs能否可靠地接手这一步? 我们在回答这个问题时,对5个家庭的10个LLMs进行了五维评价,在4个提示下,对716个安置意图进行了小于10B的参数。 我们评价翻译的性能,意向验证,幻觉,能量影响,以及对多种措辞的稳健性. 最好的配置翻译意向,严格的F1为0.943,并拒绝195种无效意向中的多达191种. 以几发的推理,最强的模型在大约百分之一的响应中会幻觉得不到支持的QoS要求,而零发的设置则会挣扎. 翻译意向费 0.044-0.148 GPU能量的WH没有推理, 加上推理的能量成本为较弱的模型带来收益。 此外,我们显示,现实的重写降低了16种组合中15种最佳模式对无效意图的拒绝,使强有力的意图验证成为可靠的IBN的关键公开挑战。 我们的代码和数据见https://github.com/ggck43/intent2slo。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en:
Edge–cloud service networks must meet fine-grained quality of service (QoS) and reliability requirements for every service they host.
Intent-based networking (IBN) lets an operator state them as a goal, e.g., “place the service on the edge, on a node with at least 4 CPU cores and the lowest memory utilization”, instead of configuring them by hand [ 1 , 2 ] .
Intent translation, the entry point of emerging management architectures like 3GPP intent-driven management [ 2 ] , RAN application orchestration [ 3 ] , and edge service placement [ 4 ] , turns this goal into service-level objectives (SLOs) that an orchestrator can enforce, grounded in the current network state.
A wrong, missing, or invented SLO can end in a wrong placement and a QoS violation.
Modern large language models (LLMs) have made this translation practical [ 5 , 6 , 7 , 4 , 8 ] .
blocks.zh:
Edge-cloud服务网络必须满足服务质量(QoS)的精细要求,以及它们所提供每一项服务的可靠性要求.
基于意向的网络(IBN)让一个操作员把它们作为一个目标来说明,例如“把服务放在边缘,放在至少有4个CPU核心和内存利用率最低的节点上”,而不是用手来配置它们[1,2].
意向翻译,3GPP意图驱动管理[2],RAN应用管弦乐[3],边缘服务定位[4]等新兴管理架构的切入点,将这一目标转化为服务级目标(SLO),由管弦乐手执行,基于目前的网络状态.
错误的,缺失的,或发明的SLO可以以错误的放置和QoS的违反结束.
现代大语言模型(LLMs)使这种翻译成为实用[5,6,7,4,8].

blocks.en:
Most of these systems, however, rely on large cloud-hosted LLMs, which take the operator’s monitoring data outside its domain and add cost to every intent. Lightweight open models have been used to translate intents into network device programs [ 9 ] and matched larger models in intent-based orchestration [ 10 ] . Existing studies evaluate mainly translation performance, often on small test sets or with large hosted models [ 4 , 5 ] , and operator-backed benchmarks assess telecom knowledge and safety [ 11 ] , but not intent-to-SLO translation.
A reliable intent translator must also refuse invalid intents, avoid inventing requirements and wasting energy, and cope with diverse phrasing. To our knowledge, no study has evaluated lightweight LLMs for intent-to-SLO translation on all of these dimensions together.
blocks.zh:
然而,这些系统大多依靠大型云托管的LLMs,它们将操作员的监测数据带出其控制范围,为每一项意图增加成本。 轻量级开放模型被用于将意向转化为网络设备程序[9],并与基于意向的管弦乐[10]中更大的模型匹配. 现有研究主要评价翻译性能,往往在小型测试机上或使用大型主机模型[4,5],运营商支持的基准评价电信知识与安全[11],但并非意向到SLO翻译.
可靠的意向翻译还必须拒绝无效的意向,避免发明要求和浪费能量,并应对各种措辞. 据我们所知,没有一项研究评价轻量级LLMs对所有这些方面的意向翻译。

blocks.en: Fig. 1: Evaluation framework. A lightweight LLM translates an operator intent and the state snapshot of the edge–cloud cluster into SLOs, or rejects the intent. Prompts are zero-shot ( zs ) or few-shot ( fs ), with or without chain-of-thought ( cot ). The output is assessed for translation performance (RQ1), intent validation (RQ2), hallucination (RQ3), energy and CO 2 e (RQ4), and robustness to operator phrasing (RQ5).
blocks.zh: 费格。 1. 评价框架。 轻量级 LLM 将运算符意图和边缘的状态快照 — 云群转换成 SLO, 或拒绝该意图 。 提示是零射(zs)或数射(fs),有或没有思维链(cot). 产出评估为翻译性能(RQ1)、意图验证(RQ2)、幻觉(RQ3)、能量和CO 2 e(RQ4),以及对操作员措辞的稳健性(RQ5)。

blocks.en:
We fill this gap with a study of ten open lightweight LLMs from five families, four prompting setups, and 716 intents.
We ask whether a lightweight model translates an intent into exactly the SLOs an orchestrator must enforce (RQ1),
rejects ambiguous, conflicting, malformed, or unsupported intents (RQ2),
and avoids inventing QoS requirements that neither the operator nor the network state supports (RQ3).
We then quantify what each translation costs in energy and CO 2 e and which deployment choices dominate that cost (RQ4), and test whether the translator holds when the same intents are rephrased in diverse ways (RQ5). Figure 1 summarizes the evaluation.
Our answers form the contributions of this work: • Translation performance (RQ1): the best configurations reach a strict F 1 F_{1} of 0.943,
on par with the Intent Engine pipeline [ 5 ] , and model family matters as much as size. • Reliable intent validation (RQ2): the strongest models reject up to 98% of invalid intents. • Hallucination made measurable (RQ3): we separate invented QoS requirements from ordinary mistakes; the best ones hallucinate in about one response in a hundred. • Energy implication (RQ4): translating an intent costs 0.044–0.148 Wh without reasoning; and reasoning multiplies this by 3.5–7.1 × \times , which pays off for weaker models. • Robustness to operator phrasing (RQ5): across three realistic rephrasing styles, both translation and validation performance degrade, with the rejection of invalid intents dropping up to 18.8 points. We release the 2,148 rephrased intents as a robustness benchmark.
blocks.zh:
我们通过对5个家庭的10个露天轻量级LLMs、4个提示设置和716个意图的研究来填补这一空白。
我们问轻量级模型是否将某种意图完全转化为管弦乐手必须执行的SLO(RQ1).
拒绝模棱两可、相互冲突、畸形或不支持的意图(RQ2),
并避免发明操作员或网络状态都不支持的QoS要求(RQ3)。
然后,我们量化能源与CO 2 e 的每一种翻译成本,以及哪种部署选择主导了这一成本(RQ4),并测试在以不同方式重新表述相同意图时,翻译是否持有(RQ5)。 图1总结了评价。
我们的答案构成这项工作的贡献: • 翻译性能(RQ1):最佳配置达到严格的F 1 F_{1}0.943,
和意向引擎管道一样 模范家庭也一样重要 • 可靠意图验证(RQ2):最强模型拒绝多达98%的无效意图。 · 幻觉可以衡量(RQ3):我们把发明的QoS要求与普通错误分开;最好的要求在大约100个反应中产生幻觉。 • 能源影响(RQ4):意向成本0.044-0.148 WH没有推理;推理将这个乘以3.5–7.1×\times,这为较弱的模型带来回报. • 强力到操作员措辞(RQ5):跨越三种现实的重写风格,翻译和验证性能都退化,拒绝无效意图下降至18.8分. 我们公布了2 148 重新表述的意图,作为稳健性基准。

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en:
Manias et al. utilize semantic routing for LLM-assisted intent-based management of 5G core networks [ 6 ] , and Habib et al. extract the intent type and keywords for a hierarchical reinforcement-learning agent [ 7 ] .
Other works translate intents to generate deployable configurations, like programs for software-defined network devices with a small language model [ 9 ] , Linux traffic-shaping commands with 2.7B–8B open models [ 12 ] , and Kubernetes resources for network-aware placement [ 4 ] . NetConfEval benchmarks LLMs on turning requirements into formal configurations [ 8 ] .
Closest to our setting, Intent Engine translates placement intents into snapshot-grounded SLOs and reports rejection and hallucination only for GPT-4.1 mini [ 5 ] , and Raptis et al. validate LLM-generated intents with symbolic guardrails [ 13 ] .
Most other works judge a translator only by how well its output matches a reference, often on small test sets (e.g., 30 requests [ 4 ] , 100 synthetic intents [ 12 ] ).
Whether the model refuses intents it cannot serve, invents requirements, or what energy each translation costs is rarely measured.
blocks.zh:
Manias等人利用语义学途径对5G核心网络进行LLM辅助意图管理[6],Habib等人。 提取等级强化学习代理商的意向类型和关键词 [7].
其他作品翻译了生成可部署配置的意向,如软件定义的网络设备的程序带有一个小语言模型[9],Linux流量造型命令带有2.7B-8B开放模型[12],Kubernetes资源用于网络感知定位[4]. 网约车 Eval基准 将要求转化为正式配置的LLMs [8].
最接近我们的设定, 意向引擎将放置意向转换为快照基底 SLO, 并报告拒绝和幻觉只针对 GPT-4.1 迷你 [5], 用象征性的护栏来验证LLM生成的意图 [13].
多数其他作品只通过翻译的输出与参考文献的匹配程度来判断翻译,这些参考文献往往出现在小型测试集上(例如30个请求[4],100个合成意图[12]).
模型是否拒绝它不能服务的意图,发明要求,或者每种翻译成本的能量很少被测量.

blocks.en: Phone et al. compare a fine-tuned 1.1B model with larger LLMs in an agentic intent-based orchestrator [ 10 ] . Ahmed et al. reported that many errors of 7B open models on telecom question answering (QA) are format failures [ 14 ] . Hammar et al. show that a fine-tuned 14B model can plan incident response better than frontier LLMs [ 15 ] . These studies target QA, troubleshooting, or orchestration, but do not address intent-to-SLO translation that an orchestrator can enforce.
blocks.zh: 电话等. 比较一个精细的1.1B型号与一个基于代理意图的管弦乐器中较大的LLMs[10]. 艾哈迈德等人. 报告说,7B开放模式在电信问答(QA)上的许多错误是格式故障[14]. 哈迈尔等人. 显示经过微调的14B模型可以比前沿LLMS更好的规划事件反应[15]. 这些研究针对QA,故障排除,或管弦乐,但不处理管弦乐手可以执行的意向到SLO翻译.

blocks.en: Definition of hallucination is often application-defined. Hammar et al. call an action hallucinated if it does not shorten the expected recovery and bound how often this happens through abstention [ 15 ] , Manias et al. report it only anecdotally [ 6 ] , and Intent Engine counts incorrect or missing values and schema violations alongside unsupported constraints [ 5 ] . In natural language generation, it is content that the source contradicts [ 16 ] . To our knowledge, no prior work separates invented QoS requirements from ordinary mistakes, or studies how lightweight translators handle ambiguous intents.
blocks.zh: 幻觉的定义往往是应用定义的. 哈迈尔等人. 如果它不缩短预期的恢复时间,并限制通过弃权发生的频率[15],则称为幻觉行动。 仅报告传闻 [6],而Intent Engine 则将不正确或缺失的值和图谋违规与无支持的制约一起计算. [5]. 在自然语言生成中,内容是来源与[16]相矛盾. 据我们所知,以前的工作没有将发明的QoS要求与普通错误分开,也没有研究轻量级翻译如何处理模棱两可的意图.

blocks.en:
Inference energy has been benchmarked per generated token for LLM serving [ 17 ] , and LLNet uses a small language model to make intent translation more sustainable [ 9 ] . However, generic benchmarks do not cover a network task with long snapshots and short structured answers, nor relate energy to performance and validation.
Robustness to rephrasing has been studied for intent-based policy generation under linguistic distribution shift [ 18 ] , but not for intent-to-SLO translation. We bring these strands together by evaluating lightweight translators on performance, validation, hallucination, energy, and robustness to phrasing in one framework, which is the evidence needed before entrusting QoS provisioning to them.
blocks.zh:
LLNet使用一个小语言模型,使意向翻译更具有可持续性[9]。 然而,通用基准并不涵盖带有长的快照和短的结构化答案的网络任务,也不将能量与性能和验证联系起来.
在语言分布转移[18]下,研究了重新措辞的强性,以基于意向的政策生成,但不用于意向到SLO的翻译. 我们通过对轻量级翻译进行性能、验证、幻觉、能量和坚固度的评价, 把这些线条汇集在一起, 在一个框架里,这是将QoS供给给它们所需要的证据。

blocks.en: III Evaluation Framework
blocks.zh: 三. 评价框架

blocks.en: III-A System Model and Task
blocks.zh: 三-A 系统模式和任务

blocks.en:
We consider a service-oriented edge–cloud system managed through intents. A monitoring pipeline exports a cluster snapshot 𝒩 \mathcal{N} that gives, for each node, its layer (edge or cloud), and its current capacity and utilization metrics. An intent e e for a service s s is a natural-language request.
The translation maps ( e , s , 𝒩 ) (e,s,\mathcal{N}) to a set of SLOs S ^ \hat{S} . Each SLO σ \sigma is a QoS requirement with a type (placement, static capacity, dynamic utilization, or network resource), a metric, a comparator, a target value, and a unit [ 5 ] .
An explicit SLO extracts a threshold from the intent (“at least 4 CPU cores”); an implicit SLO comes from a superlative request (“the lowest memory utilization”), and its value must be read from the snapshot.
For a metric m m and a requested layer ℓ \ell , the value is v ∗ = opt n ∈ 𝒩 ℓ , x m ​ ( n ) ≠ ∅ x m ​ ( n ) , opt ∈ { max , min } , v^{*}=\operatorname*{opt}_{n\in\mathcal{N}_{\ell},\;x_{m}(n)\neq\varnothing}x_{m}(n),\qquad\operatorname{opt}\in\{\max,\min\}, (1) where 𝒩 ℓ \mathcal{N}_{\ell} is the set of nodes of layer ℓ \ell (all nodes if the intent names no layer) and x m ​ ( n ) x_{m}(n) is the value of m m at node n n ; nodes that report no value are skipped. Grounding ties the SLO to the current network state.

The reference output of an intent is its ground-truth SLO set S S .
III-B Dataset
blocks.zh: 三-B 数据集

blocks.en: We use the public dataset of Islam and Calheiros [ 5 ] containing 716 placement intents on a 6-node edge–cloud Kubernetes cluster (four edge, two cloud nodes), all referring to one cluster snapshot. Of these, 521 are valid and 195 are invalid (65 ambiguous, 49 conflicting, 35 malformed, 46 unsupported). Each valid intent has a complexity level from 1 to 5, depending on the number and mix of its SLOs. The valid intents carry 1,169 ground-truth SLOs.
blocks.zh: 我们使用伊斯兰教和Calheiros[5]的公共数据集,其中包含716个放置意图在一个6节线边缘-云库伯内特斯集群(四个边缘,两个云节点)上,都指一个集群快照. 其中521条有效,195条无效(65条模棱两可,49条冲突,35条畸形,46条不支持). 每个有效意图的复杂程度从1到5不等,这取决于其SLO的数量和组合. 有效意图包括1 169个地面真相组织。

blocks.en: III-C Prompt Design
blocks.zh: 三-C 快速设计

blocks.en:
The prompts encode six requirements of the task, independent of the model: (i) a fixed output schema with the supported metrics; (ii) canonical units , with explicit conversions; (iii) grounding in snapshot , reading superlative values from the snapshot; (iv) no unstated requirements , e.g., a placement only if the intent names a layer; (v) intent validation , returning an empty SLO list, for invalid intents, with instructions to limit false rejections; and (vi) generic rules , phrased without wording from the dataset’s invalid intents.
The zero-shot prompt ( zs ) holds these instructions, the snapshot, and the intent. The few-shot prompt ( fs ) adds three invented examples, one per behavior: explicit thresholds with unit conversion, a conflicting intent, and implicit SLOs on a small invented snapshot; none resembles a dataset intent sample or shares a value with the real snapshot. The chain-of-thought variants ( zs-cot , fs-cot ) add an instruction to reason step by step before the final JSON object containing SLOs. Native reasoning (“thinking”) modes are disabled for all models.
blocks.zh:
提示编码了任务的6项要求,独立于模型:(一) 固定输出计划与支持的度量衡;(二) 条形单位,有明确的转换;(三) 在快照中定位,从快照中读取超值;(四) 没有未说明的要求,例如,只有在意图名称为一层的情况下才放置;(五) 意图验证,为无效意图而返回空的SLO清单,并指示限制虚假拒绝;以及(六) 通用规则,没有从数据集无效意图中措辞。
零射速率 (zs) 持有这些指示,快照,以及意图. 少拍即时 (fs) 增加了三个发明的例子,每个行为一个: 带有单位转换的明确阈值,一个相互冲突的意图,和一个小发明的快照上隐含的SLO; 没有一个像数据集意图样本或者与真实快照共享一个值. 思想的链式变体(zs-cot,fs-cot)在包含SLO的JSON最终对象之前,一步一步地在理性上添加一个指令. 本地推理(“思考”)模式对所有模式都是禁用的。

blocks.en: III-D Metrics
blocks.zh: 三-D计量

blocks.en:
Translation performance (RQ1). As a misconfigured SLO is as harmful as a missing one, an SLO counts as correct only if its type, metric, comparator, qualifier (highest/lowest), value, and unit all equal those of a ground-truth SLO. Pooling true positives, false positives, and false negatives over all intents gives the strict micro- F 1 F_{1} , which weights every SLO equally.
We also report the exact-match rate EM = 1 | V | ∑ i ∈ V 𝟏 [ S ^ i = S i ] \mathrm{EM}=\frac{1}{|V|}\sum_{i\in V}\mathbf{1}[\hat{S}_{i}=S_{i}] over the valid intents V V , because the orchestrator can enforce an intent only when its whole SLO set is right.
blocks.zh:

As over-eager rejection harms service availability, we also report the false-rejection rate ϕ \phi , the share of valid intents answered with S ^ i = ∅ \hat{S}_{i}=\varnothing .

Hallucination (RQ3). Not every deviation from the ground truth is a hallucination. A value off in its last digit, “ < < ” for “ ≤ \leq ” or an empty value is a mistake , as the model asserts nothing that the inputs contradict.
An SLO is hallucinated if it asserts a requirement or value that the intent text, its numbers, and the cluster snapshot do not support, e.g.,
a placement on a layer the operator never named, or a value that is not the requested metric’s value in snapshot. blocks.en:
The 28,640 responses from 10 models × \times 4 prompts × \times 716 intents contain 15,181 distinct (intent, SLO) pairs that do not match the ground truth, which is far beyond manual labeling.
For valid intents, the hallucination rules (in the repository) are applied as deterministic rules against intent and snapshot.
For invalid intents, we must infer ground-truth SLOs from free text. We used an LLM-assisted procedure with Claude Sonnet 5.5,
a model not among those evaluated,
which read each of the invalid intent texts under these rules and produced a per-intent specification (layers, metrics, directions, numbers), which was then applied automatically to every returned SLO.
A human annotator checked 250 stratified labels (125 valid, 125 invalid), covering every rule at least twice and every model 25 times, and agreed with 93% of cases.

10个型号的28,640个响应x\times 4 prools x\times 716 意向包含15,181个与地面真理不符的区别(intent,SLO)对,这远远超出了人工标记.
对于有效的意图,幻觉规则(在寄存器中)作为针对意图和快照的决定性规则适用.
对于无效的意图,我们必须从免费文本中推断出地面真相。 我们使用LLM辅助程序 与克劳德·索内5.5,
一种不在被评价之列的模式,
,然后自动适用于每个返回的SLO。
一名人名注释员检查了250个分级标签(125个有效,125个无效),覆盖了每个规则至少两次和每个型号25次,同意了93%的案件.

blocks.en: Energy and emissions (RQ4). Energy efficiency is a design requirement of next-generation networks, and an always-on translation service adds to the energy budget of the infrastructure. We measure the GPU energy of each request with the NVIDIA management library (NVML) energy counter, the same source used by inference-energy benchmarks [ 17 ] . We report energy per intent (Wh), and operational emissions CO 2 ​ e = E × PUE × CI \mathrm{CO_{2}e}=E\times\mathrm{PUE}\times\mathrm{CI} , where E E is the energy, PUE is the power usage effectiveness of the data center and CI is the carbon intensity of the grid. Load levels, PUE, and grid scenarios are given in Section IV-D .
blocks.zh: 能源和排放(RQ4)。 能源效率是下一代网络的一项设计要求,而且始终提供翻译服务,增加了基础设施的能源预算。 我们用NVIDIA管理库(NVML)的能量计数器测量每个请求的GPU能量,与推论-能量基准所使用的源相同[17]. 我们报告每个意图的能量(Wh),而运行中的排放CO 2 e = E × PUE → CI\mathrm{CO_{2}e}= E\times\mathrm{PUE}\times\mathrm{CI},其中E是能量,PUE是数据中心的功率使用效果,CI是电网的碳强度. 第四至D节列出了负载水平、PUE和网格方案。

blocks.en: Robustness (RQ5). For each phrasing variant, we report the change Δ ​ M = M variant − M original \Delta M=M_{\text{variant}}-M_{\text{original}} of a metric M ∈ { F 1 , ρ } M\in\{F_{1},\rho\} from RQ1 and RQ2, so that a negative value is a loss caused by phrasing alone.

blocks.en: III-E Robustness to Operator Phrasing
blocks.zh: III-E 操作员的强健性

blocks.en:
The dataset intents are short, one-line requests, whereas operators can write intents in quick notes, often with context, in lists, or in a hurry.
We rewrote each intent in three compound variants (Table I ): C1 (wrapped request) keeps the request close to the original or lightly reworded and wraps it with task-related opening and closing sentences; C2 (restructured request) rewords the request, reorders its constraints, and adds one sentence on the service’s role; C3 (noisy list) turns it into a list with typically 3–5 typos and common shortcuts (e.g., “pls”, “mem”), followed by a short closing.
blocks.zh:
数据集的意向是短的,单行请求,而操作者可以在快速注释中写出意向,通常与上下文,列表,或者匆忙.
我们按三种复合变体(表一)改写了每一种意图:C1(被包装的请求)将请求保留在与最初或轻轻的重写上,并用与任务有关的起始句和结尾句来包装;C2(被修改的请求)将请求重新措辞,重新排列其限制,并在服务作用上增加一句话;C3(无声列表)将其变成一个通常带有3-5字和常见快捷键(如 " pls " , " mem " )的清单,然后是简短的结束句。

blocks.en: TABLE I: The three phrasing variants of one valid intent (RQ5).
blocks.zh: 表格 页:1 一个有效意图的三种变体(RQ5).

blocks.en:
The rewriting rules preserve the meaning: numbers, units, service names, layer words, etc., are never changed by a typo. Added sentences contain no numbers, metrics, or hints about validity; and every invalid intent keeps its defect (e.g., a malformed fragment stays broken). Each variant therefore keeps the ground-truth SLO set of its original intent.
The 716 intents yield 2,148 variants, which we release as a robustness benchmark. They were written one intent at a time with LLM assistance (Claude Sonnet 5.5), following the definitions (C1–C3) above, and automatic tests check that every variant keeps the numbers, units, service, layer, and superlative words of its original, and that added sentences are unique and digit-free.
A human reviewer then checked all three variants of 100 randomly drawn intents (50 valid, 10 per level; 50 invalid, 12–13 per category) with 95% agreement. For each variant, the reviewer judged whether it keeps the ground-truth SLOs of its valid intents and, for an invalid intent, also its defect.
blocks.zh:
重写规则保留了意义:数字,单位,服务名称,层字等,从未被打字所改变. 添加的句子中没有数字,度量,也没有关于有效性的提示;而每一个无效的意向都保持其缺陷(例如一个畸形的碎片仍然被打破). 因此,每个变体都保留了原始意图的地面真实SLO。
716的意向产生2,148种变体,我们作为稳健性基准发布. 它们是在LLM协助下(Claude Sonnet 5.5),按照上面的定义(C1-C3),一次写出一个意向,并自动测试检查每个变体保留其原作中的数字,单位,服务,层,和叠加的单词,加上的句子是独一无二和数字自由的.
随后,一名人审查员检查了所有三种变体,即100个随机提取的意向(50个有效,每级10个;50个无效,每类12-13个),协议率为95%. 对于每个变体,审查者都判断它是否保持其有效意图的地面真实性,对于无效意图,也判断其缺陷。

blocks.en: IV-D RQ4: Energy and Emissions
blocks.zh: IV-D RQ4:能源和排放

blocks.en:
An intent-translation service runs beside the infrastructure it manages, so its energy adds to the network’s energy budget.
We measured it for the three most accurate families in RQ1. Each model ran with vLLM on its own H100 NVL GPU with the prompts of RQ1, and no other process on it.
Energy was read from the NVML counter [ 17 ] . We measured 11,808 requests at three load levels: one request at a time (as in a lightly used service), 16 and 64 concurrent requests (where batching raises efficiency at the cost of latency).
No intent was repeated, so no complete prompt was served from the cache.
Energies for all 521 valid intents are estimated from a per-model linear fit on generated tokens ( R 2 ≥ 0.996 R^{2}\geq 0.996 ).
blocks.zh:
意向翻译服务在它所管理的基础设施之外运行,因此它的能量增加了网络的能源预算.
我们为RQ1中三个最精确的家庭测量了它. 每个型号在自己的H100 NVL GPU上与vLLM一起运行,并带有RQ1的提示,上面没有其他进程.
从NVML计数器读取能量[17]. 我们在三个负载级别上测得11 808项请求:一次1项请求(如使用简便的服务)、16项和64项并行请求(分批可提高效率,但需花费时间)。
没有重复任何意图,所以没有从缓存中发出完整的提示.
对所有521项有效意图的能量,根据生成的代币(R 2 ≥ 0.996 R^{2}\ }\ }\ q 0.996)上每型号的线性配体估计.

blocks.en: Served one request at a time, an intent costs 0.044–0.148 Wh without reasoning and 0.18–0.58 Wh with it (Figure 5 ). Reasoning multiplies the energy per intent by 3.5–7.1 × \times . This buys 26–28 F 1 F_{1} points for Gemma-4-E2B, 13 for Ministral-3-3B ( fs ), and at most 2 points for Qwen3.5 and Ministral-3-8B. Qwen3.5-9B often answers the fs-cot prompt directly, without writing out its reasoning, so its fs-cot costs are similar to fs . Its zs-cot answers do contain reasoning.
blocks.zh: 一次满足一个请求,一个意图成本 0.044-0.148 (中文(简体) ). WH 无推理和0.18-0.58 WH与它(图5). 理由将每个意向的能量乘以3.5–7.1×x\时间. 这为Gemma-4-E2B、Ministry-3-3B(fs)和Quen3.5和Ministry-3-8B购买了26–28 F 1 F_{1}分数,最多为2分。 Quen3.5-9B经常直接回答fs-cot的提示,而不写出其推理,所以它的fs-cot成本类似于fs. 它的zs-cot答案确实包含推理.

blocks.en:
Serving 64 requests at once instead of one at a time lowers the energy per intent by a factor of 3.2–20.2 (median 6.1). This happens most for the reasoning setups, whose long generations benefit most from batching.
The price is latency, as the 95th-percentile response time rises from 0.8–3.2 s to 10–27.5 s without reasoning and from 2.1–20.4 s to 24.5–71.2 s with it. So an operator can batch delay-tolerant intents (e.g., planned deployments) and serve urgent ones individually.
At realistic rates, however, the GPU’s idle power dominates the energy. For a dedicated GPU (idle draw 101–108 W) loaded to at most 50% of its throughput under a 30 s latency bound, idle draw is 81–97% (median 93%) of the 2.5–3.2 kWh it consumes per day at 10,000 intents.
With an industry-average PUE of 1.56 [ 19 ] and the 2025 world grid intensity of 0.458 kg CO 2 e/kWh [ 20 , 21 ] , this is 0.18–0.67 g CO 2 e per intent.
The data center’s location changes it about 16-fold, from 0.016–0.061 g in France to 0.26–0.98 g in India.

blocks.en: V Conclusion
blocks.zh: 五 结论

blocks.en:
We asked how far lightweight LLMs can go in intent-to-SLO translation. Our findings show that with few-shot reasoning, models of 4–9B parameters can reach a strict F 1 F_{1} up to 0.943, stop up to 98% of invalid intents, and rarely invent QoS requirements, at a fraction of a watt-hour per intent.
Their limits are implicit values, intent validation that weakens under natural phrasing, and energy dominated by idle time.
In practice, few-shot prompting should be the default, reasoning used for models where it adds performance, and the translator paired with a deterministic check of implicit values and SLO consistency. Our evaluation uses a single cluster snapshot, and energy was measured on an on-premises GPU. On edge accelerators, the absolute values will differ, while the relative effects of reasoning and batching are expected to hold.
These findings open research directions for AI-native network management, such as open benchmarks with realistic operator phrasing to harden intent validation, and energy-aware placement and scheduling of the translator on shared accelerators. Extending the evaluation to intent assurance in 3GPP intent-driven management and to multi-turn clarification of ambiguous intents will show how far lightweight models can carry closed-loop QoS management beyond translation.
blocks.zh:
我们问轻量级LLMs在SLO的意向翻译中能走多远. 我们的研究结果显示,用很少的镜头推理,4–9B参数的模型可以达到严格的F 1 FQQQ1} 高达0.943,停止高达98%的无效意图,并且很少发明QoS要求,每个意图只有1瓦时的一小部分.
它们的极限是暗含的值,在自然措辞下削弱的意向验证,以及以闲置时间为主的能量.
在实际操作中,几发提示应该是默认,在它增加性能的模型中使用的推理,而翻译者对隐含值和SLO一致性进行定型检查. 我们的评价使用单一的集群快照,能量被测量到一个promise的GPU. 在边缘加速器上,绝对值会有所不同,而推理和批量的相对效果预计会保持.
这些调查结果为AI-内在网络管理打开了研究方向,例如开放基准,采用现实的操作者措辞来硬化意图验证,以及将翻译人员能量意识放在共享加速器上并安排时间。 将评价范围扩大到3GPP意图驱动的管理方面的意向保证,以及多回合澄清模棱两可的意图,将显示轻量级模型除了翻译之外还能在多大程度上承担闭锁式QoS管理。
